proposed.text: A commercial office building (500 sqm) has: lighting 5 VA/sqm, 200 receptacles at 180 VA each, 8 kW water heater, and 5 kW HVAC motor. What is the total connected load before demand factor?
proposed.rationale: Connected load = sum of all nameplate/unit values. Lighting = 500 x 5 = 2,500 VA. Receptacles = 200 x 180 = 36,000 VA. Water heater = 8 kW = 8,000 VA. HVAC motor = 5 kW = 5,000 VA. Total = 2,500 + 36,000 + 8,000 + 5,000 = 51,500 VA. The original '58,500 VA' answer over-counted by 7,000 VA; the model-generated rationale itself admitted the sum equals 51,500 VA. Source: PEC 220.12 general lighting and receptacle/appliance load provisions.
proposed.explanation: Total connected load = 2,500 + 36,000 + 8,000 + 5,000 = 51,500 VA before any demand factor.
